conventions.convention: The sample covariance uses divisor N. The graphical-lasso penalty sums over all ordered matrix entries, including diagonal entries; the off-diagonal-only penalty defines a separate objective.

Graphs are finite, simple and undirected. Global separation tests pairwise disjoint vertex sets. Clique potentials are strictly positive and finite; no equivalence between factorization and Markov properties is asserted.
Conditional independence uses bounded measurable real test functions and almost-sure conditional-expectation identities under the explicitly assumed AC convention.
The Gaussian precision-zero equivalence requires positive-definite covariance and distinct indices. For p=2, conditioning on the remaining coordinates means conditioning on the trivial sigma-algebra.

RBM states are binary 0/1, energy is −aᵀv−bᵀh−vᵀWh, and absent-edge weights are fixed to zero. Finite contrastive divergence starts at the observed visible state and replaces the negative phase by its finite k-step law; it is not asserted to equal the likelihood gradient.

The procedure uses positive finite sweep budgets, resets the block coefficient vector to zero, restores original coordinate indexing, and accepts candidates only after a positive-eigenvalue test. Its properties assume exact real arithmetic and exact finite-dimensional matrix operations; no convergence or optimizer guarantee is asserted.

load_bearing.statement: For symmetric positive-semidefinite S, positive-definite Θ and λ>0, F(S,λ)(Θ)=log det Θ−tr(SΘ)−λ∑ᵢ∑ⱼ|Θᵢⱼ|, including diagonal entries.

For p≥1, S positive semidefinite and λ>0, the all-entry objective is strictly concave and attains a unique maximizer. A feasible Θ is that maximizer iff Θ⁻¹−S−λΓ=0 for symmetric Γ with diagonal entries 1 and the stated entrywise sign/subgradient conditions.
Assume AC. For X with law Nₚ(μ,Σ), p≥2 and Σ positive definite, Xᵢ and Xⱼ are conditionally independent given all remaining coordinates iff (Σ⁻¹)ᵢⱼ=0, for every distinct i,j.
The finite binary energy model has product Bernoulli layer conditionals, the displayed exact likelihood gradients, and the separately defined finite-k contrastive-divergence components.

For p≥2, S positive semidefinite, λ>0 and positive integer budgets R,K, initialize W=S+λI, perform the specified finite block and soft-threshold coordinate updates with positive-definiteness guards, and return failure or W⁻¹.

Under AC, defines finite simple undirected graphs, pairwise and global Markov properties through conditional independence, and strictly positive finite-state clique factorization without asserting their equivalence.
